title: Marryandbride hero
description: A full-bleed first screen as tall as the window (less a thin bar's height): on phones one photo, from 1024px a 50/50 split of a film on the left and a photo on the right. A small uppercase line, a serif uppercase title and a charcoal button sit at the lower left of the photo. It stays pinned at the top while the rest of the page slides up over it.
notes: the pin is position: sticky; the sections after it need their own background and a higher stacking layer (the page wraps them in relative z-10 bg-background) to slide over it
the text is text-background over ink-tinted placeholders; with real photos keep them darker at the lower left
media slots: a video (desktop left half) and a photo; both are cropped like object-fit: cover
